schema.description: One appointment with a clinic or practitioner. Written by hand readings of notes compiled from appointment emails, and of documents that show a visit. Version 2 adds source_time and requires it, every other rule unchanged.

date.description: The appointment's date and time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in Sydney local time; 00:00 when time_unknown is true. This is the fact time.

id.description: Identity, chosen by the reader: a slug for the provider and the date.

kind.description: The appointment type as the booking named it, close to its wording; where a visit is known only from a document, what that document records happening (such as a summary being printed).

location.description: The address as the source gave it.

note.description: Anything else the reader took from the source about this visit.

outcome.description: What came of the visit, in the reader's words: what a later document shows followed from it, or that no result was found.

provider.description: The practitioner or practice as the source named them.

purpose.description: What the visit was for, as the booking or the note gave it, briefly; the times of separate parts in brackets when there are several.

specialty.description: The provider's field, in the reader's words, lower case.

time_unknown.description: True when the source gives the day but no time, so the 00:00 in date is a placeholder. Absent otherwise.

source_time.description: How the visit's clock was read: value is date as the records file wrote it, a time to the minute or midnight as a placeholder where time_unknown is true, read in zone. The records files state Australia/Sydney, the zone this Definition reads date in, with basis source. Required.

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.
